configuration.seedDesign: independent method-specific seed labels; each of the five methods receives exactly N seeds
configuration.policyContract: uses current phase, reachable nodes, current visible rewards and public costs; never reads hinted event rewards, future battle results, or future reward candidates
configuration.policyNotes: Prioritizes reachable rest at 18% missing HP or shop at 20% missing HP when recovery is affordable; otherwise prefers common battles. Uses a fixed talent plan; does not use reforge or temper.

enemyStatAdjustment.note: Applies only to cloned enemy entity stats in memory; player stats, runtime node values, seed, and YAML files are unchanged.

targets.finalAct: standalone final battle; reported only among runs entering act 5
targets.interpretation: Pass rates are conditional on the selected deterministic policy; they are not measured human-player win rates.
